# Independent reviewed withdrawal wire references

This finite corpus contains142 positive cases,80 negative cases and9 raw framing cases, independently projected from frozen contracts and prior public fixture references. Binding correlation failures are separate from shape failures. It covers both fixture identities, all journal phases, request commands, reviews, action states, response errors, selector mistakes, amount/fee arithmetic and exact-owner binding changes. No new Go, browser or runtime output is an expected value. Modeled outcomes are not actual chain observations.

The producer source and inputs were locked before execution and received a separate review. Python3.14 and3.9 produced identical bytes. Run `python3 reproduce.py` without replacing the checked-in reference. The known-address model is finite, not a general address implementation. Existing immutable draft headings retain provenance; the freeze record states adoption.
